verdict_reason: Identified 3 high-severity implementation defects (omitted cgroup directory in storage monitor, un-enabled track_wal_io_timing, and 100ms docker exec process forking contention) that must be patched before launching the 6-trial pilot.

review_1_database_baseline_fingerprints.recommended_fingerprint: Aggregate balance and ID bounds check: sum(abalance)==0, min(aid)==1, max(aid)==100000*SF, sum(bbalance)==0, sum(tbalance)==0, n_dead_tup==0

detected_defects: StorageMonitor.take_snapshot() in docker_runner.py is invoked without passing cg_dir, resulting in empty container cgroup io.stat in live runs
Primary device detection uses hardcoded heuristic (0n1, sda, vda) which can latch onto incorrect disk if Docker data is on secondary mount
review_2_storage_classification.recommended_rules: Classify STORAGE_BOUND only when device busy time is high AND request queue depth (weighted_io_ms / duration_ms) or await latency is elevated

review_3_cfs_correlation.timestamp_consistency: pgbench uses UNIX epoch seconds; resource_monitor uses monotonic seconds. Inter-cluster intervals are calculated strictly from pgbench epoch timestamps.
review_3_cfs_correlation.period_boundary_type: Temporal periodicity (recurrence interval matching 100ms), not absolute phase alignment to kernel CFS epoch
review_3_cfs_correlation.vulnerability: CONTROLLED_CAUSAL_EVIDENCE can be assigned if caller passes has_controlled_experiment_confirmation=True without automated multi-experiment verification
review_3_cfs_correlation.rule_enforced: A temporal match alone must never produce a causal conclusion

review_4_evidence_classification.detected_defect: VALIDATED rule only checks len(supporting_experiment_ids) >= 2, allowing duplicate replications of the same configuration to pass as a validated controlled experiment
review_4_evidence_classification.recommended_fix: Require explicit control_experiment_id, treatment_experiment_id, and single manipulated_variable in PerformanceFinding model

review_5_postgres_permissions_and_monito.pg16_compatibility: Fully compatible (supports pg_stat_checkpointer and pg_stat_io with fallback)
review_5_postgres_permissions_and_monito.missing_settings_impact: In vanilla PostgreSQL, track_wal_io_timing defaults to off, causing wal_write_time and wal_sync_time to silently record 0.0 ms
review_5_postgres_permissions_and_monito.missing_metrics_representation: Unavailable views are captured in unavailable_metrics list

estimates.cfs_10ms_sampling: <0.3% of 1 host CPU core (kernfs read in memory)
estimates.database_fingerprinting: 0.0% during active benchmark (boundary only, ~15ms at SF=2)
estimates.postgres_100ms_sampling: 3% - 8% of container CPU (spawns 10 docker exec and psql backend processes/second)

review_6_monitoring_overhead.contention_risk: HIGH: PostgresPeriodicSampler at 100ms creates excessive process forking and connection churn in 1.0 vCPU container
review_6_monitoring_overhead.recommended_pilot_design: 2x2 factorial pilot (uninstrumented, CFS only, Postgres sampler only, fully instrumented) measuring TPS and p95 delta

proposed_minimal_fixes.description: Add -c track_io_timing=on -c track_wal_io_timing=on to PostgreSQL container startup flags
Add aggregate balance checksum (sum(abalance)==0, sum(bbalance)==0, sum(tbalance)==0) and n_dead_tup==0 to baseline verification
Adjust default pg_sample_interval from 0.100s to 0.500s to eliminate process-forking overhead
Require explicit control_experiment_id, treatment_experiment_id, and manipulated_variable for VALIDATED classification
